description: Diff windows (one per file, label diff-<hash>): core APIs including events, plus closing themselves and renaming themselves. `destroy` is needed as well as `close`: a close with an unsaved edit is intercepted, the edit flushed, and the window then destroyed. `set-title` is needed because a diff window can be pointed at another file after it opens, and the native title is set once at creation and does not follow `document.title` — without it the taskbar would name the file the window was opened with forever. `core:window:default` grants getters only, so each of these has to be listed.
